memories.content: On 2026-09-19 the Clay & Co group show happened; Mara exhibited three bowls under her own name and a stranger bought one.

entities.name: Wen
entities.description: Mara's pottery teacher who hugged her at the show

memories.content: On 2026-09-17 Mara learned she got the permanent ICU position at the General; the permanent contract starts 2026-10-01, the same day Daniel moves to Toronto.

entities.name: the General
entities.description: Toronto General Hospital, where Mara won the permanent ICU position

memories.content: Priya came to Mara's 2026-09-19 show and brought back the celadon bowl Mara had given her in June to show how far her pottery had come.

entities.name: Priya
entities.description: Mara's close friend and fellow ICU nurse; distinct from manager Priyanka

memories.content: Mara reflected (2026-09-19) that after a spring when everything felt far away and breaking, her big open questions had resolved the way she chose: permanent ICU, Daniel moving to Toronto, a bowl sold, her mother stable and planning a Christmas visit.
Mara tends to distrust good news and only with effort let herself stand in it (noted 2026-09-19).
Daniel planned to fly to Toronto the weekend after 2026-09-19 to flat-hunt with Mara ahead of his October move.
At the 2026-09-19 show a stranger bought one of Mara's bowls, the first time a stranger paid money for something she made by hand.
